newsitem.title: USA: Kohlberg Kravis might bid for DFS Group - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Kohlberg Kravis might bid for DFS Group - WSJ.

text.p: Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co is interested in making a bid for DFS Group Ltd, a duty-free retailer, the Wall Street Journal reported on Friday.
The newspaper said Kohlberg had told the retailer's four controlling shareholders that it was interested in submitting a bid.
It said it did not discover the bidding price that it Kohlberg might be contemplating.

The newspaper said the shareholders were divided among themselves over whether to sell DFS to LVMH Moet Hennessy Louis Vuitton, which had agreed to pay $2.47 billion for 58.75 percent of the group last month.
It quoted a spokesman for LVMH as rejecting Kohlberg's interest.
"Such an offer isn't allowed under the terms of the agreement with LVMH's majority shareholders," he said.
